name: After § 9
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 9a. Regrets that the delays and implementation difficulties related to the support loan to Ukraine are resulting in additional costs for the Union budget; stresses that these costs should not be borne by European taxpayers; calls on the Commission to strengthen expenditure controls, prevent irregularities, and ensure the effective recovery of any unduly paid funds;
